kxced3tb.sourceDescription: No Christmas is complete without some sugar and spice - exactly why this 2.4m inflatable for Christmas, from HOMCOM, is a must for you this year. The shell is made from durable polyester, which is IP44 rated to ensure it's safe for outdoor use and against light/mild water. Inside the Christmas outdoor decoration, there are five LED lights which gently illuminate the shell and create a fun atmosphere especially at night. Automatically inflates and deflates when plugged in/out. ● Tall 2.4m cute and smiling gingerbread man design, holding a striped candy cane ● Shell is made from durable and weather-resistant polyester. IP44 rated, safe for light/mild outdoor use ● Inner lights to illuminate for a cool atmosphere at night ● Mains powered, inflates and deflates quickly and easily ● Comes with inner fan, 4 x guy ropes, 7 x ground stakes and 3 x sandbags Color: Yellow Type: Inflatable Gingerbread Man with Candy Bar Material: Polyester Cloth Overall Dimension: 170W x 65D x 240Hcm Power Cable Length: 3m LED Light Power: 0.48W Fan: DC 12V/0.85A Input voltage: 220-240V/50HZ, Output voltage: DC 12V/ 1.0A Certification: IP44, UKCA, CE-EMC, RoHS Item Label: 844-380V70 NOTE 1: Ensure air blower is always connected to keep decoration inflated 2: Please don't place it outdoor in hard rain or snow! Warning: this product is not a toy. Keep away from children unless under adult supervision. Keep away from open flames and heat sources. If powered, disconnect before cleaning or storage and do not use if damaged. Keep batteries away from children and dispose of used batteries safely.
